_comment: Roo Code (formerly Roo Cline) MCP configuration. Save to the Roo Code MCP settings file — open it via Roo Code's 'MCP Servers' panel -> 'Edit Global MCP' (or 'Edit Project MCP' for .roo/mcp.json). Roo Code uses the flat 'mcpServers' format. The 'alwaysAllow' array auto-approves listed tools so the agent can call them without per-call confirmation. Replace the vault path before use.
